To attend grad school without disrupting your busy work schedule, you could choose to enroll on a part-time basis. This method allows you to devote more time to a job. Part-time grad school enables quicker progression in a career compared to a full-time program focusing on major career development.
If you choose to go to grad school as a part-time student, you generally study less in two years. Attending part-time grad school might actually be more expensive than expected, as it involves taking fewer classes. Engaging in part-time grad school may limit your ability to join job-related activities, participate in study abroad programs, or internships, which are typically available to full-time grad school students.
